title: Prescription Drug Coverage Considerations
source: Dugan K et al. JAMA Network Open. 2025;8(4):e252834 — eAppendix 4
question_text: What are my options for Medicare prescription drug coverage, and how should I choose?

accurate_complete: You can choose either a Medicare Advantage Plan that covers prescription drugs OR a stand-alone Part D plan
Most Medicare Advantage options include prescription drug (Part D) coverage
If you choose Original Medicare, you could purchase a separate prescription drug (Part D) plan
Each plan has a different list of covered drugs — choose based on the medicines you take
Each plan has different out-of-pocket costs for different drugs — choose based on your medicines and comfort with costs
accurate_incomplete: Some (but not all) of the prescription drug coverage considerations were substantively discussed
not_substantive: None of the prescription drug coverage considerations were substantively discussed
Counselor said they do not know
Otherwise did not substantively answer the question
incorrect: Incorrect information was provided that was substantive enough to materially change the substance of the answer or affect an enrollee's coverage decision

scoring_notes: All 5 criteria must be covered for Accurate and Complete. The two most important are the MA vs. stand-alone Part D distinction and the guidance to choose based on your specific drugs. The 20% accurate_complete baseline suggests most counselors cover some but not all of this.
